{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Meatloaf|Meatloaf]] | [[Cookbook:Meat Recipes|Meat Recipes]] | [[Cookbook:Midwestern cuisine|Midwestern U.S. cuisine]]

==Ingredients==
*1 ½ [[Cookbook:Pound|pounds]] (675 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Ground Beef|ground beef]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] Ritz [[Cookbook:Cracker|crackers]]
*2 beaten [[Cookbook:Egg|eggs]]
*8 [[Cookbook:Ounce|ounces]] (225 g) [[Cookbook:Tomato Sauce|tomato sauce]]
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
*¼ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Pepper|pepper]]

==Procedure==
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 350°F (180°C).
#Pound the Ritz crackers until fine like [[Cookbook:Bread Crumbs|bread crumbs]].
#In a separate bowl, add the meat and the other ingredients and mix with your hands until the mixture is smooth.
#Grease a glass [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|baking dish]] with vegetable [[Cookbook:Shortening|shortening]].
#Put the meat mixture in the pan and shape like a football.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the oven for 1 hour.
#Take out the meat loaf and serve warm.
